project.name: TableStory Recipe App Rebrand
project.summary: Transform Pocket Cinema into a responsive recipe product with a recipe-domain API, mobile experience, TV navigation, and complete verification.

tickets.title: Add the recipe data model and API
tickets.spec: Add a deterministic recipe collection and recipe-specific API alongside the existing application so frontend work can consume a stable contract.
acceptance_criteria: The collection contains at least 12 complete recipes
Search includes ingredients and dietary tags
Cookbook add, list, and remove behavior works

tickets.title: Create the TableStory design system
tickets.spec: Create reusable brand tokens and responsive recipe-card styling using the approved warm kitchen palette.
acceptance_criteria: All five approved colors are defined
Recipe cards and artwork respond at mobile widths
Focus and saved states do not rely only on color

tickets.title: Build the mobile TableStory experience
tickets.spec: Replace the mobile cinema interface with recipe browse, search, detail, ingredients, steps, and My Cookbook interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Home displays the TableStory identity and exact tagline
Search matches recipe and ingredient content
Details show metadata, ingredients, and ordered steps
My Cookbook controls expose saved state

tickets.title: Add the television recipe experience
tickets.spec: Add TV recipe rails, ten-foot layouts, and keyboard or remote browse and detail navigation while retaining mobile behavior.
acceptance_criteria: TV mode renders four named rails
Arrow keys and Enter operate browse cards
Escape and Backspace return from detail

tickets.title: Complete documentation and terminology verification
tickets.spec: Document startup and verification, remove obsolete film data, and add an automated partial-rebrand terminology check.
acceptance_criteria: README documents mobile and TV startup
Automated checks reject customer-facing cinema terminology
